tags.notes: Taipei Metro (MRT). The v3 endpoint https://tdx.transportdata.tw/api/gtfs/V3/Map/GTFS/Static/Rail/TRTC works and is the live source, but authorization is a client_credentials token exchange rather than a fixed credential, so it cannot be registered as static_current: the platform fetcher has no token and returned 401 nightly. A custom script fetches it and uploads feed versions directly, skipping the upload when the zip sha1 already exists, so a run that produces no new version means TDX has not republished rather than that the fetch failed.
